test_title: PYST 25: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 20th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Convert the sentence from passive to active voice:

The documents were reported to have been misplaced by the clerk.

options.text: The clerk reportedly misplaced the documents.
The clerk is reported to misplace documents.
It was reported the documents misplaced.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 
 
• The sentence is in the passive voice: "The documents were reported to have been misplaced by the clerk." 
 
• In passive voice, the subject of the active sentence becomes the object, and the object becomes the subject. 
 
• To convert this sentence to active voice: The clerk (original object) becomes the subject of the new sentence. 
 
• The correct structure in active voice is: "The clerk reportedly misplaced the documents." 
 
• Option 1 is correct because it follows the correct active voice structure. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**. 
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"The clerk reportedly misplaced the documents."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 
 
 
• **Option 2: **"The clerk is reported to misplace documents." – Incorrect as it changes the tense and meaning of the original sentence. 
 
• **Option 3: **"It was reported the documents misplaced." – Grammatically incorrect sentence structure. 
 
• **Option 4: **"The documents reported clerk misplaced." – Grammatically incorrect and confusing sentence structure. 

47:T
